details.publicNotes:
Legendary, gravity-defying beanstalks known as azappuses grow rapidly, seemingly endlessly, eventually puncturing the clouds. While the mature stalks primarily threaten soil nutrients, the supermassive seeds of azappuses present a different kind of threat as they magically glide on zephyrs or gales like dandelion seeds, their four vines flailing and their filaments dancing with sizzling lightning currents.

Azappus seeds gravitate toward fertile soil near water sources, such as most farmlands. When they find a potential place to germinate, they conjure brutal winds and summon pulverizing lightning to raze buildings, slay nearby creatures for fertilizer, and soften the ground. Unfortunately for farming communities, the seeds are picky and often destroy multiple sites before choosing a favorite.

In some regions, fear of the seeds' destructive power has morphed into mystical interpretations of their origins. Since these vandals seemingly manifest from the sky, some people speculate that azappuses are created by the gods or even that they are minor divinities in their own right. Reports from the few who have climbed all the way to the top of an azappus stalk speak of strange, magical realms above the clouds inhabited by creatures of air.

Shocked

A shocked creature is electrically charged, making it easy for electricity to harm it. It's off-guard against attacks that deal electricity damage (even if it's only additional electricity damage, such as a shock weapon) and takes a –2 circumstance penalty on Fortitude and Reflex saving throws against electricity effects. The shocked condition normally lasts for the duration listed, but it ends early if the creature takes any amount of electricity damage from a source other than persistent electricity damage or if they spend an Interact action to discharge the electricity harmlessly. This condition first appeared in Battlezoo Eldamon.

Monster Parts 1,250/2,800/5,150 gp

description.value: An azappus seed can navigate even the most perilous gusts with ease. It does not treat wind as difficult terrain or need to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Qf1ylAbdVi1rkc8M]{Maneuver in Flight} in high winds.

20 feet. Powerful winds buffet and propel the azappus seed. The air within the aura is difficult terrain for flying creatures that do not have the air trait. Creatures starting their turn in the aura that are not @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the azappus seed must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:35] save. Flying creatures that fail are pushed just outside of the aura, while creatures standing on the ground or another solid surface are knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

The azappus seed generates a cylinder of tornado-force winds within 60 feet that blow directly down toward the ground, affecting all creatures in the area except itself. The cylinder has a @Template[burst|distance:25]{25-foot radius} and is 100 feet tall. The cylinder sends airborne creatures careening toward the ground. Flying creatures in the area that fail a @Check[reflex|dc:37] save are launched toward the ground in a bubble of air, taking @Damage[4d6[untyped]] damage as they land; they are knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} on a critical failure. If the cylinder includes the ground, all creatures and unattended objects on the ground then take @Damage[15d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:37|basic] save). The azappus seed can't use Crushing Gale for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

The azappus seed fills the air around it with devastating arcs of lightning. All creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] take @Damage[4d12[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:37|basic] save). Creatures that fail the save are @UUID[Compendium.battlezoo-bestiary-es-pf2e.sf2e-effects.Item.1fZbuJEbVmE3J4XL].

Requirements The azappus seed's last action was Lightning Storm

Effect A deafening roar of thunder emanates from the azappus seed, dealing @Damage[5d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] (@Check[fortitude|dc:37|basic] save). Creatures within the superstorm aura that fail are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 minute, or for 24 hours on a critical failure.
